pages.title: Prime Singularity
pages.text: Prime shards compressed into one point. Primes cannot be divided, and the singularity seems to have inherited that indivisibility. It is perfectly smooth and cannot be split or cut by anything. Every attempt to halve it simply returns the whole thing again.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Primes cannot be factored, so I wondered if they could be compressed. The Singularity Compactor forced countless shards into one point that is still, somehow, prime.
